fixed.geometry: assets/round_socket_exact (scripts/build_round_socket_exact.py): 32-gon base z 0-10 mm + 32 convex wall wedges z 10-40 mm whose inner faces sit at apothem 12.000 mm (inscribed bore exactly 12 mm; audit in geometry_audit.json); same meshes in both engines; peg = cylinder radius 12 mm - clearance, half-length 25 mm, mass 0.08 kg, solid-cylinder inertia
fixed.frame: all poses are in the tilt plane through a flat-face centre of the 32-gon bore (azimuth 5.625 deg about z), where the bore radius is exactly 12.000 mm on both sides; centre_inplane_mm is along that direction, tilt_deg tilts the peg top toward the negative in-plane direction
fixed.release: at rest, no actuation, gravity only; 3-s run. free_entry: lowest point 2 mm above the rim top; rim_rest: bottom face on the rim top; wedge: exact two-point contact
fixed.perturbation: U(+-0.05 mm) perpendicular to the tilt plane only (keeps the analytic contact geometry); identical arrays for both engines
fixed.labels: free_entry and rim_rest: geometry / statics as before. wedge: 2D rigid-body contact-mode analysis at release (peg_hole_statics.release_modes); held_in_wedge only where static hold is the unique consistent mode over mu/1.2..mu*1.2; inserted where no static solution exists at 1.2 mu. Rev 5's wedge labels used static feasibility alone, which is necessary but not sufficient: the smoke test (both engines) and this analysis show a consistent (slide-, slide-) mode at those poses.
fixed.correct_rule: inserted: final centre z <= 36 mm, final radial <= clearance, final tilt <= atan(2c/30 mm) + 0.5 deg, settled (last 0.5 s z-range <= 0.5 mm, speed <= 5 mm/s). held_in_wedge: never drops more than 5 mm below its start, tilt change <= 5 deg, settled (held and inserted end ~23 mm apart). held_on_rim: final |z - z0| <= 1 mm, tilt change <= 5 deg, settled. Pre-lock settling (max displacement, tilt change) and a strict rigid-ideal hold (<= 0.5 mm, <= 0.5 deg) are reported as numerical metrics, not used for correctness.
fixed.outcomes: each valid rollout: inserted / stuck (not inserted, on or in the socket; reports whether it held in place) / ejected (centre radial > 50 mm); invalid (non-finite, truncation, or tunnelling) counted separately
fixed.pass_gate: rollout correct iff its outcome matches the cell's analytic label under fixed.correct_rule; invalid rollouts are reported separately and count as not correct
fixed.numerical_health: peak/final penetration split into base/rim and bore-wall; penetration-assisted flag (success with wall penetration > 0.5 x clearance); reported, never part of correctness
fixed.hold_tolerance_note: the hold tolerances were set after the rev-6 smoke test: with the original 0.5 mm / 0.5 deg rigid-ideal tolerance every engine failed holds it clearly made (wedged pegs stayed at z ~ 58-60 mm vs 35 mm inserted) because compliant contacts settle 1-2 mm while the contact force builds from zero; the strict metric is still reported

selection_rule: total correct count over the two selection cells (one held_in_wedge at 1.25 mu*, one inserted at 0.75 mu*, same geometry), so neither a too-soft (slips when it should hold) nor a too-sticky (holds when it should slide) setting can win; then fewer invalid rollouts, then lower mean peak bore-wall penetration, then wall time
selection_note: two selection cells, same geometry (clearance 0.75 mm, tilt 16 deg shallow wedge): mu 0.55 -> held_in_wedge (unique-hold window for this pose is about 0.40-1.90; 0.55/1.2 = 0.46 sits near its lower edge, i.e. medium) and mu 0.12 -> inserted (mu* = 0.160; 0.12 = 0.75 mu*)
seed_rule: selection: seed0; held-out cell j: seed0 + 1000 + j
dropped_ambiguous_cells: wedge combinations where static hold is possible but not unique (e.g. tilt 5-10 deg at mu 0.8) are excluded

tilt_deg.wedge: deep wedge 5 (c 0.5) / 8 (c 1) deg; shallow wedge 14 (c 0.5) / 20 (c 1) deg

lateral_offset.free_entry: centred / shifted by half the allowed range
